name: wet-area-bathroom
description: WET-AREA BATHROOM (v0.31.9.33): a bathroom narrower than 1.6 m gets a shower SCREEN (0.9 x 0.06) instead of a 0.9 x 0.9 cubicle, which is how an HDB bathroom of 2-3 m2 is actually built and frees the floor its WC and basin needed. Asserts tpl-studio's st-bath carries a WC, a basin AND a screen, then shoots it.

steps.name: boot-splash-gone
steps.failMessage: #boot-loader still covering the screen; every screenshot before this point is the loader (v0.31.9.6).

steps.name: assert-wet-area-fitout
steps.eval: (()=>{const st=window.__store.getState();const r=st.floorPlan.rooms.find(x=>x.id==='st-bath');if(!r)throw new Error('no st-bath');const inRoom=st.items.filter(i=>i.position[0]>=r.origin[0]&&i.position[0]<=r.origin[0]+r.width&&i.position[1]>=r.origin[1]&&i.position[1]<=r.origin[1]+r.depth).map(i=>i.defId);for(const need of ['toilet','bathroom-sink','shower-screen']){if(!inRoom.includes(need))throw new Error('st-bath missing '+need+'; has '+inRoom.join(', '))}if(inRoom.includes('shower'))throw new Error('st-bath got a 0.9x0.9 cubicle, not a screen')})()
steps.failMessage: a bathroom under 1.6 m wide must carry a WC, a basin and a shower SCREEN (v0.31.9.33)
